subject: Security discovery — post-call action plan & subprocessor follow-up
messages:
From: Jamie Huang <jamie.huang@nimbusretail.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: security discovery & initial asks

Thanks for the call earlier today — good overview of Redwood's runtime and routing capabilities. As promised, here are the security/compliance items we need to validate before moving to procurement: 

1) Current SOC 2 status and whether you have a Type II report available.
2) Subprocessor list (all cloud and managed service vendors) + data residency for each.
3) Confirmation on GDPR data processing (standard contractual clauses / EU data flow controls) — we have users in the EU.
4) HIPAA posture: while we don't expect PHI on the platform today, we need to know if Redwood supports customers with PHI and the controls you have for BAA discussions.
5) Initial security questionnaire — attaching our SQ (nimbus_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx). Please acknowledge which sections will require a security team response vs a sales/legal answer.

We're hopeful we can get the SOC 2 and the subprocessor list this week so our InfoSec can kick off their review. Preferred timeline: SOC 2 + subprocessor CSV by end of week (Fri 21 Aug).

Thanks,
Jamie
Head of Security Operations
Nimbus Retail

Attachments: nimbus_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Huang <jamie.huang@nimbusretail.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery & initial asks

Jamie — great to meet you today, and thanks for the clear list. Quick recap and plan from our side: 

- SOC 2 Type II: we have a current report (coverage through June 2026). I'll attach the report summary and provide the full Type II by tomorrow morning (we typically provide a signed NDA before the full report).
- Subprocessor list: attaching our canonical CSV (redwood_subprocessors_list.csv) with vendor names, their roles, and region. Note: core infra includes GCP (us-central1), AWS (eu-west-1) for some model hosting, and a managed logging provider.
- GDPR: we support SCCs and have data processing addenda; we will flag any EU-residency specifics in the CSV.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports customers operating under HIPAA but onboarding requires our Private deployment path and a signed BAA. I will include a short note on the steps.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll upload the SOC 2 Type II summary + redwood_subprocessors_list.csv to the Drive link I shared by EOD Thu (20 Aug).
2) Rishi (cc) will own the technical responses on encryption, key management, and incident response; he’ll add comments to your SQ by Fri.
3) Can we set a 30-min follow-up on Mon 24 Aug to walk through any sq items that need clarification? If that works, please send a calendar invite.

I’ve attached the CSV and a short one-pager (sq-initial-nimbus.pdf) that calls out the most common Qs for retail customers.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_list.csv; sq-initial-nimbus.pdf
From: Elena Park <elena.park@nimbusretail.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Jamie Huang <jamie.huang@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery & initial asks

Thanks Olga — appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- EU data: we need confirmation of whether any inference requests originating from EU customers are routed through eu-west-1 hosting only, or whether data may transit other regions (we require residency for EU retail customers).
- Encryption/KMS: please confirm whether Redwood offers customer-managed keys (CMK) or only provider-managed keys for hosted deployments. If CMK is available, what KMS providers are supported?
- Logging/audit access: we will require read-only audit logs for the integrations team during PoC (30 days retention minimum).

On HIPAA: not a blocker for us today, but we want to understand the path if we expand into partner health services.

Timeline reminder: our security team needs the SOC summary and subprocessor CSV by end of day Fri 21 Aug to keep the procurement timeline intact.

Elena
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Nimbus Retail
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Security discovery — post-call action plan & subprocessor follow-up

Looping you both in — below are the items Nimbus needs for procurement to proceed. I’ve attached the SOC summary and the subprocessor CSV to this thread (also uploaded to Drive).

Immediate asks for Rishi (security team):
- Confirm whether customer-managed KMS is available for hosted deployments and list supported KMS vendors (GCP KMS, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault). We should call out any limitations (e.g., not available on shared tenancy).
- Provide a short bullet response for: encryption at rest (yes), encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+), key rotation cadence, and whether we provide read-only audit log export for customers.
- Confirm whether EU-origin requests can be pinned to eu-west-1 model hosts and whether we can support EU-only residency for inference requests.

Suggested reply plan (Olga): I’ll send Nimbus a single consolidated email with: SOC 2 summary, subprocessor CSV, answers to the three KMS/encryption bullets, and proposed calendar slots for Mon 24 Aug 09:00 or 15:00 PT for a short follow-up.

Vanessa — please help prioritize this for Rishi; procurement is timeboxed.

Thanks,
Olga
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference

Forwarded attachments: redwood_subprocessors_list.csv; SOC2-summary-202606.pdf
